document.about: An invented table of depots printed to PDF by headless Chrome on macOS (fixtures/chrome-table-blank-band.html): ruled cell by cell, its regions' rows set apart by a blank grey band merged across the four columns, ten points tall.

notes: Reprint with: Chrome --headless --no-pdf-header-footer --print-to-pdf=chrome-table-blank-band.pdf chrome-table-blank-band.html, then update the sha256.
A blank band thinner than a cell is no row of the grid at all, and never ended the table; the fixture's band is as tall as the DOE contract summaries' (pdf-table-across-blank-separator-band).

checks.issue: The table ended at the first band: the rows under it were a table of their own, headed by its first row (`South | Calder Wharf`).
As above, the row under it.
